_DESCRIPTION: v3.5 §5a/5b smoke-test target. Single airliner flying due east along y=0 from x=-30km to x=+30km over 240s. Designed to traverse two test polygons (mountain at [-15,+15]km, rain at [+5,+35]km) so detection-count differences across polygon edges are easy to see in the scan log. Uses waypoint behavior so the file is round-trippable through the path editor (loadFromJSON supports waypoint behavior only).
